text:
Maria: Heads-up, stuck at the airport. Flight delayed ~6+ hours, can't make the 22:00 UTC primary handoff tonight. Really sorry for the late notice — I need someone to take primary from 22:00-06:00 UTC. I can try to hand over what I have now.

oncall-bot: Reminder: rota shows Maria as primary for tonight (22:00-06:00 UTC). If you're swapping, follow the takeover checklist: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/oncall-takeover :clipboard:

Alex: I can cover 22:00-02:00 UTC if someone else can take 02:00-06:00?

Sam: I can take the whole shift if needed — I'm free tonight. @Maria any active incidents or tickets I should know about before I take full primary?

Maria: No active critical pagers right now. One customer ticket in "waiting for logs": RED-1234 (low urgency). A couple of notes: we've seen occasional mem spikes on inference-worker pods after large-batch reruns. If you see worker OOMs, runbook says to scale + restart. Also we picked up a canary quantization change earlier today (applied to canary only).

Lee: I've pinged infra to warm an extra replica for the night (just in case). Also toggled canary routing off for heavy models for the window 22:00-06:00. Runbook link: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/inference-worker#scale-and-restart

Sam: Ok taking primary. I'll create the bridge and update the rota now. If anyone wants to shadow early hours, ping me.

oncall-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/5112233445 — On-call assignment updated: Sam (primary), Alex (secondary). :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Pager status summary: no active pages. Last page for inference latency was ~2 hours ago (resolved by infra team).

Sam: Adding handover runbook snippet to the bridge notes:

```
# quick triage commands (prod)
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-worker
kubectl -n prod logs deployment/inference-worker --tail=200
# scale if mem/latency spike
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/inference-worker --replicas=5
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/inference-worker
```

Maria: Thanks Sam — I added you to RED-1234 and shared the last log excerpts in the ticket. Vault keys are fine; I added Sam to the vault policy for the night. Sorry again for the late ask. :airplane:

Alex: :thumbsup: I can shadow 22:00-02:00 and step in for any noisy alerts. I'm on UK time and reachable on Slack/phone.

Sam: Acknowledged. Monitoring plan: I'll watch p50/p90 latency dashboards and token throughput. If p90 > 250ms or error rate spikes > 0.5% for 5m, escalate to @Lee infra and follow the "model-surge" runbook. Contact list in bridge: Lee (infra), Alex (shadow), Maria (handover notes).

Maria: One last note — the maintenance window earlier at 17:00 rolled out a quantization tweak on canary only; observe any regressions in output quality and notify product if something odd shows up. Good luck and thanks again.

Sam: I'll post a short status update at 23:30 UTC and again at 03:00 UTC unless anything comes up.
